title: 1828 Prairie's front gains the stone range south of its bay
items: 1828 Prairie (the Shipman house) now has a plain, windowless stone range at the south end of its front, beside the canted bay and full height under the cornice, as the street photograph of about 1900 shows it. The 1893 Rand McNally street view draws the same strip, and the 1876 permit's 35 ft front leaves room for it. The 1911 fire map does not show it, and the liberty says so.
